extracted.name: The Perfect Mai Tai
extracted.description: Whip up this big batch Mai Tai recipe for the best party ever! Then sit back, relax, and talk with your friends while sipping on tasty, tropical cocktails.
instruction_lines: Combine all three rums, Curaçao, almond syrup, simple syrup, and lime juice in a large jar or drink cooler. Stir together, then top off with orange juice.
